title: Ember model card sidecar
description: Optional sidecar selected with --model-card. Supplies model-specific output limits, sampler defaults, a thinking terminator hint, reasoning-effort budgets, and advisory context-extension provenance.

source.description: Upstream model card from which the defaults were transcribed.

verified_at.description: ISO 8601 date on which the values were checked against the source.

max_tokens.description: Default combined reasoning and visible-output token cap.

hard_limit_reply_budget.description: Tokens reserved after `</think>` for visible output. When the remaining budget reaches this reserve during thinking, Ember injects `thinking_terminator_hint`. The DeepSeek fallback is 1024.

thinking_terminator_hint.description: Directive injected verbatim when the thinking budget hook fires. Include `</think>` when the hint must force the transition to visible output. An empty string disables injection.

sampling.description: Sampler defaults used when the request omits the corresponding field.

reasoning_effort_tiers.description: Per-tier reasoning budgets, clamped so the visible-output reserve remains available.

context_extension.description: Advisory static-YaRN recipe. A sidecar never activates scaling; the operator must pass the architecture-specific CLI opt-in and exact context.

enabled_by_default.description: Static YaRN must remain an explicit operator opt-in because it also changes short-context inference.

notes.description: Provenance, caveats, or measured deviations from the upstream card.
